reason: I'd grab the free 14 days since there's no auto-charge, but on day 14 I'd most likely drop back to the free tier. Free rain sounds and a 30-minute off timer are basically what I already do on YouTube, and I'm trying to cut subscriptions, not add one.
objection: A few minutes' difference in my own 14-day record could just be a good week, not the app. And on iPhone I still have to tap a button when I wake up, so the 'resumes where it stopped' part isn't really automatic for me. The automatic version is 2028 and needs an armband I'd have to buy.
would_change_my_mind: If the day-14 record showed I was clearly falling asleep a lot faster, like 10+ minutes, every night and not just on a few, I'd pay 4,900 for a month to see if it holds.
